# Raw-source adapter fixtures

These fixtures are deliberately small slices of real New Jersey Department of
Education artifacts. They exercise the transport/parser boundary without making
offline tests depend on NJ DOE availability. They are not complete datasets and
must not be used for analysis.

`provenance.json` records each upstream HTTPS URL, the SHA-256 digest of the
artifact used to generate the fixture, the fixture digest, and the extraction
rule. Enrollment, assessment, SPR, and finance fixtures are regenerated by
`tools/generate-source-fixtures.py`. The directory endpoint is protected from
automated downloads, so `tools/generate-directory-fixture.R` extracts one real
district row from the state-derived statewide directory bundle and leaves raw
fields not retained by that bundle blank.

The enrollment fixture intentionally retains published 2019-20 `>95` cells.
Its characterization test protects the package's existing `97.5` midpoint
transformation and the derived enrollment values required by this project.
